observation: Both pages carry the Tell Me Baby brand for Australian parents with lang en-AU and a footer reading '© Tell Me Media Pty Ltd 2021'. The titles differ: the original's is 'Tell Me Baby | Australia's Biggest Baby Product Review Website' and the AI-built page's is 'Tell Me Baby – Baby product reviews by Australian parents'.
The original sets all text in the Montserrat web font (889 elements). The AI-built page uses only a system-ui font stack (274 elements) and loads no web fonts.
Body text is 16px on both pages. Line height is 24px on the original and 25.6px (1.6) on the AI-built page.

The original's h1 is 55px, weight 400, white and left-aligned over a darkened hero photo. The AI-built page's h1 is 54.4px, weight 700, dark slate rgb(32,39,44) and centred on a light background. Each page has exactly one h1.
The original's section titles are centred, regular-weight black Montserrat, and its h2s measure 24px at weight 500. The AI-built page's h2s are 33.6px bold and left-aligned.
Each AI-built section heading is followed by a short grey one-line subtitle, such as 'Eight places to start.' or 'Four simple steps.'. The original's section titles have no subtitles.

The heading outlines differ. In the original, the h1 is followed directly by h3 footer and newsletter headings and then h2s for hidden modal forms (Login, Sign up, Forgot password), and the visible section titles are not in the outline. The AI-built page runs h1 → seven section h2s → h3s without skipping levels.

The landmark structure differs. The original is div-heavy (528 divs) with 7 header elements, 12 sections, and no main or article. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 main, 7 sections, 4 articles and only 28 divs. Both have 1 nav and 1 footer, and neither uses aside, figure or blockquote.

Both palettes use peach rgb(255,170,145). In the original it is paired with soft teal rgb(125,196,204), used as text colour on 307 elements, and body text is black. The AI-built page has no teal and pairs peach with dark slate rgb(32,39,44) text, pale blush rgb(255,241,236) and burnt orange rgb(196,71,42).

The original's CTA pills ('View all categories', 'Join TMB Rewards', 'Read more reviews', 'Read more', Signup) have a teal fill and white bold text. The AI-built page's CTA pills ('Sign up', 'Search', 'View all categories', 'Join TMB Rewards', 'Join now') have a peach fill and dark bold text. Both centre their standalone CTAs below sections.
The original's first DOM button is 'Reset', with a transparent background and 0 radius. The AI-built page's primary button is 'Sign up' in peach with a 999px radius.

Both headers are white bars with the 150×40 SVG logo at the left, nav links after it, and Login plus a pill sign-up button at the right. The original is about 75px tall and includes a small search field and dropdown menus with carets. The AI-built bar is 65px tall with plain nav links and a thin bottom border, and its Sign up pill is peach rather than teal.

Both pages use a 1440×540 lifestyle photo of a parent and baby in the hero. The original shows it full-bleed with a dark rgba(0,0,0,0.5) overlay and white text on top, with empty alt. The AI-built page scales it to 1080×405 inside the content column, with feathered edges, over a peach-to-white gradient, and gives it a descriptive alt.

The original places the hero search as a large white pill field at the right of the hero, next to the left-aligned h1. The AI-built page centres a single pill search form below the h1 and subtitle. It has a dark 2px outline, a peach 'Search' button and a visually hidden label.
The original shows the search field twice, in the header (placeholder clipped) and in the hero. The AI-built page has one search form, in the hero only.

Both pages have 8 category tiles. In the original they are square-cornered photo tiles (about 265×200) in two offset rows of four, each with a white line icon and a white label on a dark-overlaid photo. In the AI-built page they are white, rounded, hairline-bordered 168×112 cards with an emoji icon and a bold label, set six in the first row and two in the second.
The original's icons are line pictograms and SVG stars, with 8 SVGs and 1 emoji. The AI-built page uses 8 emoji as category icons and has 0 SVG icons.

In the original, 'How it works' shows four small text steps scattered at irregular offsets with blank icon areas, on white, followed by a teal 'Join TMB Rewards' pill. In the AI-built page it is a full-bleed blush band holding an ordered list of four equal cards, each with a peach numbered badge, followed by a peach CTA.

Both pages centre a 728×90 SunRice leaderboard ad between sections at x=356. The original's alt is 'SunRice Advertisement' and it has a hidden second ad (a 0×0 Sudocrem mobile banner). The AI-built page adds a small uppercase 'SPONSORED' label and uses the alt 'Sponsored promotion'.

The original's trending products are three white shadowed cards with product images, half-star peach ratings and grey review counts, and the first card is flush to x=0 and clipped. The AI-built page shows four text-only bordered cards with a burnt-orange rank numeral, the product name and a blush pill for the review count.
The original's product cards are meant to show product images, but many render blank (lazy-loaded). The AI-built page's product, review and award cards contain no product images at all.

The original's Recent reviews are three equal shadowed cards, each with an image area, star row, title, quoted truncated excerpt and a round avatar with a name. The AI-built page uses four <article> cards in a three-column grid, with the fourth alone on a second row. They have an underlined h3 title, an excerpt and a grey 'Review by Name' byline, with no stars, avatars or thumbnails.
The original's review excerpts are wrapped in quote marks, truncated with an ellipsis, and paired with filled-peach and outlined star ratings.

The AI-built page places a right-aligned, underlined burnt-orange 'More reviews →' link on the same row as the Recent reviews heading. The original instead puts a centred teal 'Read more reviews' pill below the cards.

Both pages show the '2021 Tell Me Baby Award Winners' in a four-column grid with a category label above the product name, a short last row and card heights that vary with text length. The original is on white, with teal 'Highest rated …' labels, black names, product images and navy ribbon badges. The AI-built page is a dark slate band (about 1645px tall) of 31 text-only bordered cards, with peach uppercase labels and white names.

The original's cards are square-cornered with a soft drop shadow (50 box-shadows), and only pills and avatars are rounded. The AI-built page uses 0 box-shadows and gives its cards rounded corners (38 at 8–15px, 22 at 16px+) with 1px borders.

Both pages list five Recent articles as headline-only text links with no thumbnails or dates. The original shows them as plain left-aligned teal links followed by a centred teal 'Read more' pill. The AI-built page shows them as full-width rows separated by hairline rules, each ending in '→', with a right-aligned 'Read more →' link beside the heading.

Both pages close with an about block and a TMB Rewards pitch naming Kmart, Coles and Target with a 'Join now' call to action. The original is a text-only, left-aligned SEO block followed by a centred promo with a bold 'Join now' link. The AI-built page uses a two-column layout: copy and a blush rounded 'TMB Rewards' callout card with a peach pill on one side, and a group photo on the other.

Both pages include a peach dots decoration (tmb-dots-peach) and a picture-alt image. In the original these are footer images at 0×0, not rendered. In the AI-built page they render in the About section, with the dots overlapping the photo's corner by about 5500px².

The original's footer is white and holds collapsed uppercase accordions ('TELL ME BABY', 'BRANDS', 'COMMUNITY', 'HERE TO HELP') with + icons, social icons stacked with visible bullets, and the logo beside the copyright. The AI-built footer is a dark slate band with the logo and copyright on the left and underlined white text social links on the right, and has no link groups.

The original's DOM contains hidden UI that does not appear on screen: Login, Sign up and Forgot password modal forms and a newsletter signup, with 6 forms, 25 inputs and 21 buttons. The AI-built page has 1 form, 1 input and 1 button.

The original is 9077px tall with a full-bleed hero and a content column of about 1140px. The AI-built page is 6029px tall, and everything, including the hero image, sits in a 1080px column from x=180 to x=1260.
The original lays out with flex only (40 flex, 0 grid). The AI-built page uses both flex (58) and grid (6).

Neither page leans on a utility framework, but the class and inline-style counts differ. The original has 1407 class uses across 383 unique classes (10.9% Tailwind-like), 140 inline style attributes and 4 style elements. The AI-built page has 211 class uses across 42 unique classes (0.9% Tailwind-like), 4 inline style attributes and 1 style block.
Neither page uses animations or backdrop blur, and each has one gradient background. The original has 0 transitions and 20 transforms. The AI-built page has 55 transitions and 0 transforms.

The original's head carries heavy third-party and SEO scaffolding: 52 scripts, 37 metas (including Open Graph, Twitter, verification and origin-trial tags), 2 JSON-LD blocks and a generator tag. The AI-built page has 0 scripts, 0 external stylesheets, 3 metas (charset, viewport, description) and no JSON-LD.
Both pages have alt_missing 0, with empty alt on decorative images. The original has 11 images, 8 SVGs and 38 ARIA attributes. The AI-built page has 6 images, 0 SVGs and 15 ARIA attributes.

Both pages have a white body background and generous vertical spacing between sections. The original separates sections by whitespace alone, with no colour bands. The AI-built page alternates full-width bands: white, blush, white, dark slate, white.

Both pages use friendly copy in Australian English ('mum', 'dummy', 'pram') and name Kmart, Coles and Target. The original has 798 words, 3 exclamation marks and repeated 'Highest rated baby X' labels. The AI-built page has 760 words, 0 exclamation marks, short fragment subtitles and bare uppercase category labels.

Link styling in the AI-built page varies by context: bold undecorated nav links, underlined review titles, burnt-orange underlined 'more' links and underlined white footer links. Many cards are whole-card anchors (76 anchors in total, against 138 in the original).
